purpose: Execute the candidate-exposed forcing-boundary primary experiment after Reference-only adjudication, preserving the exact P2E16 rho matrix and P2E14 thresholds while separating route-domain evidence from pairwise scientific-admissibility evidence.

stage_A_frozen_findings_used_as_design_m.rule: The 27 Stage-A failures are retained exactly. They are not removed, replaced or used to alter thresholds. They remain eligible for route-admission/fail-closed endpoints but are excluded prospectively from pairwise scientific-discrepancy admission inference.

matrix.materials: all 36 D3R materials B01-B18 and O01-O18
matrix.case_order: material major, then effective_saturation, then boundary axis TOP then BOTTOM, then rho ascending

H1_route_domain.support_rule: RossFast route-valid for every abs(rho)<=1 case and route-invalid for every abs(rho)>1 case, with Reference fixed-step route valid.

H2_scientific_admissibility.population: the 850 Stage-A threshold-transfer-valid cases with abs(rho)<=1
H2_scientific_admissibility.support_rule: Both routes valid and every one of the five immutable P2E14 discrepancy metrics <= the exact-Se threshold.

H3_fail_closed.support_rule: Reference fixed-step route valid; RossFast does not publish a converged candidate; no automatic Reference fallback or alternate accepted solver identity.

orthogonal_case_status.reason: Route-domain and scientific-discrepancy inferences are deliberately separate so the 27 Stage-A threshold-transfer failures cannot be silently discarded or misclassified as RossFast failures.

hypotheses.P2E16_H1: The exact production forcing envelope predicts RossFast route validity across material and common-state axes.
hypotheses.P2E16_H2: Where P2E14 threshold transfer is independently valid, route-valid inside/boundary RossFast cases remain scientifically admissible without threshold widening.
hypotheses.P2E16_H3: Just-outside requests fail closed with no silent fallback or converged RossFast publication while the matched Reference request remains valid.

required: exactly 1296 cases attempted in frozen order
all 36 materials and three Se anchors retained
both boundary axes and all six rho levels retained
fixed-solver-seam source blobs remain identical to P2E15/P2E16A authority
unexpected scientific results do not fail the harness

primary_claim_if_supported: The current RossFast state-local prescribed-flux contract defines a reproducible two-sided forcing admission boundary across all 36 materials and common state anchors; within the independently Reference-valid threshold-transfer subset, scientific solver substitution remains admissible through the inclusive boundary, and just-outside requests fail closed.
failure_interpretation: Route mismatches falsify or narrow the contract-domain description. Pairwise failures within the 850 authorized cases narrow the scientific substitution domain. The 27 Stage-A threshold-transfer failures remain limitations of threshold transfer and are never counted as RossFast discrepancy failures.
next_permitted_action: Implement the fixed 1296-case candidate boundary harness, runner and workflow exactly as frozen. No performance, transaction, groundwater or production-envelope mutation is permitted.
